services.name: Zoo Camps
services.desc: The Cougar Mountain Zoo Internship Program is designed to introduce college students or graduates seeking theoretical as well as hands on experience in the many facets of the zoo world. Participants are exposed to a broad range of fields inherent in zoo operations such as education, conservation, fundraising, public relations, animal husbandry, medical, and many others. Fill out and submit the Internship Application online by using the link below. Please include a CV and Cover Letter. Once your submission has been reviewed, you will be contacted on proceeding to the next phase. Selected interns must have a flexible schedule and the ability to work weekdays and weekends. services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Guided Tours are designed to introduce your group to the immense beauty and mysteries of the Earth’s vanishing wildlife. Since the tour will be especially designed for your group, advanced reservation and a deposit are required. Your request for the level of sophistication, subject matter and length of presentation is given careful consideration. During the tour, your guide takes you from habitat to habitat as you experience a unique encounter with the animals and enjoy the opportunity of taking a deep glimpse into the world of other life forms.
